states.name: Mastery
states.description: Correct reasoning. The learner finds a common denominator, converts both fractions, and adds only the numerators, producing the correct sum.

states.name: Denominator-addition misconception
states.description: The learner adds numerators together and denominators together (a/b + c/d = (a+c)/(b+d)), a very common early error when adding fractions.

states.name: Numerator-addition misconception
states.description: The learner keeps a denominator but adds numerators without finding a common denominator, or otherwise mishandles the numerator/denominator relationship.

states.name: Procedure error
states.description: The learner attempts a valid overall strategy (e.g. common denominators) but slips on a step such as scaling, giving a result that can look similar to the denominator-addition answer.
